title: Neoforge generate command survival
description: The mod allows you to run the /neoforge generate command in hardcore/survival mode in single-player.
body: This mod enables the use of the /neoforge generate command in survival and hardcore single-player worlds, removing the usual restriction that limits it to creative mode. It seamlessly integrates the built-in NeoForge chunk generator, allowing you to pre-generate terrain,without leaving your difficulty mode. Ideal for server-like world preparation, performance optimization, or simply experimenting with generation mechanics, it gives you full control over your world's landscape while maintaining the survival challenge. Works flawlessly in vanilla-style gameplay.
